literal_meaning: দৃষ্টি বা নজর দেওয়া (to give gaze or attention literally)
figurative_meaning_en: to pay attention, to keep an eye on
example_sentences_in_bangla: শিশুটির উপর নজর রাখো যেন সে বিপদে না পড়ে।
example_sentences_in_english: Keep an eye on the child so he doesn't get into trouble.
note: The idiom is used in a positive sense to request attention without negative connotations.
